title: Sonu Textiles Business Website

requirements.text: Create a visually rich homepage for Sonu Textiles with a hero banner, business name, tagline in both Hindi and English, and navigation links to all sections (Clothing, Mehndi, About Us, Contact).
acceptanceCriteria: Business name 'Sonu Textiles / सोनू टेक्सटाइल्स' is prominently displayed
Navigation links to Clothing, Mehndi, About Us, and Contact sections are visible
Hero section contains both Hindi and English text
Page loads without errors

requirements.text: Implement a Clothing section displaying a product gallery with sample clothing items. Each item should show a name (Hindi + English), description, and price. Include an 'Order Now' button on each product that opens an order form.
acceptanceCriteria: Clothing products are displayed in a responsive grid gallery
Each product card shows name in Hindi and English, price, and a description
Clicking 'Order Now' opens an order form modal or page
Order form collects customer name, phone number, address, and selected product
Order submission stores the order in the backend

requirements.text: Implement a Mehndi section with a design gallery (sample mehndi design images), a pricing/rates table in Hindi and English, and an appointment booking form.
acceptanceCriteria: Mehndi design gallery displays at least 4 sample design images in a grid
Rates/pricing table is shown with service names and prices in both Hindi and English
Appointment booking form collects name, phone number, date, time, and service type
Submitted appointment bookings are stored in the backend
Confirmation message is shown after successful booking

requirements.text: Create an About Us page/section describing Sonu Textiles, its services (clothing and mehndi), and contact details. Content should be available in both Hindi and English.
acceptanceCriteria: About Us section is accessible from the navigation
Section contains business description in both Hindi and English
Section mentions both clothing and mehndi services

requirements.text: Add a Contact Us section with a contact form collecting visitor name, phone number, email, and message. On submission, store the enquiry in the backend. Also display a phone number and location placeholder for the business.
acceptanceCriteria: Contact form is present with fields: name, phone, email, message
Form submission stores the enquiry in the backend
A success message is displayed after submission
Business phone number and address placeholder are displayed alongside the form

requirements.text: Implement a language toggle button (Hindi / English) in the navigation bar that switches all UI text throughout the site between Hindi and English.
acceptanceCriteria: A language toggle button is visible in the navigation bar
Clicking the toggle switches all visible text between Hindi and English
Selected language preference persists during the session
All sections (Clothing, Mehndi, About Us, Contact, Home) respond to the toggle

requirements.text: Apply a warm, festive, and elegant visual theme to the website — using rich jewel tones such as deep red, gold, and ivory — inspired by traditional Indian textile and mehndi aesthetics. Use decorative typography, consistent spacing, and an overall look that feels premium yet welcoming for a local Indian business.
acceptanceCriteria: Color palette uses warm, rich tones (e.g., deep red, gold, ivory) consistently across all sections
Typography feels elegant and readable in both Hindi and English
Visual style is consistent across all pages/sections
The design feels appropriate for a clothing and mehndi business

constraints: Business name must be displayed as 'Sonu Textiles / सोनू टेक्सटाइल्स'
All user-facing text must support both Hindi and English languages
Do not use blue or purple as primary colors
nonGoals: Payment gateway or online payment processing
Real-time chat or customer support chat
SMS or email notification on booking/order
